fresh_response.generator: Unchanged crazydart.learning.collect pilot, count6, seed20260920; all six generated parents assigned evaluation-only regardless of saved legacy split labels. No fit uses them.

fresh_response.truth_failure: Keep earlier finite valid horizons when a later state fails; report planned/available counts and no numerical clipping of truth.

inherited_task.prelude: Actual50steps of train00 command prefix hover .65195631980896 per channel. Save51 observations/50 issuedcommands; fork same resulting plant state without reset/padding. Structured latent from issued history only, never simulator applied thrust.

dart.proposal_evidence: Persist flattened optimizer proposal, expanded commands, active_steps, and causal-input anchor before every actual gradient kernel call; save objective and full gradient arrays afterward, preserving NaNs and exceptions. No extra model forwards for logging.

decision.dart_contact: Separate unchanged all-four-check task verdict; not a substitute for direct response evidence.
decision.failure_policy: Keep all failed gates. If research acceptance fails, do not adopt refinement into the consumer recipe; remove unused experimental implementation rather than deprecate it. Saved source and results remain in git/evidence.
decision.inherited_v4_wind_tail_guards: Report unchanged v1-vs-v4 guard limits on the new candidate separately. Existing failures remain obligations; no claim those passed merely because refinement beats shared-v1.

evidence.before_science: Commit complete harness, tests and implementation; bind exact source and runtime and inherited inputs. No fitting, new model predictions or native simulations until bound.
evidence.capture: Actual stage-start/end, immutable cache+weights, stage-one identity, every optimization event/checkpoint and selectedmodel; preserve incomplete/failed work.
evidence.contract: No consumer option, platform dispatch or simulator parameters enter learner; stage-two remains research-only unless accepted. No new envelope coverage or derivative-accuracy qualification.
evidence.integrity: External SHA anchors, complete file inventories and source/runtime identity; preserve raw failures.
evidence.replays: Exact saved candidate checkpoints/objectives/predictions, native confirmation/response truth, independent score reduction and candidate nominal control replay; zero refits/optimizer calls.

mechanism: One additional full 1.2 s free-running recursive supervision stage after the existing shared-physics short stage. No head, physics, optimizer algorithm, controller, vehicle assumptions or recording-parent additions.

physical.collection_order: All three refinement attempts have sealed outcomes before fresh confirmation.
physical.excluded_offsets: Original test seeds plus0..14000000 in1000000 increments and all training/development parents.
physical.roster: Inherited v1 cells/query plans and pilot, change only test seed shift from+14M to+15M.
physical.scoring: Inherited physical component endpoint/prefix RMSEs, hierarchical geometric aggregates, floors and parent p95. Fresh confirmation scored separately from inspected+14M.
physical.source_policy: Native collection/replay in pinned historical oracle source; baseline inference in pinned source or proven unchanged complete inference closure; no fit through reference importer.
physical.truth: Identical native truth and eligibility masks for every arm; preserve failures and missing parents.

training.channel_weights: Exact15 fixed weights from each stage-one fit report.
training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum finite weighted long-development loss among step0 and every100 attempts; no test selection.
training.error_scale: Per future step/channel maximum of training persistence RMS and0.01*saved initial state_scale. Training data only; freeze before refinement.
training.failure_policy: Nonfinite initial loss/gradient, exhausted wall limit or failed fit is a recorded scientific failure. No alternative horizon, seed, restart or fallback fit.
training.loss: Uniform mean over all future time steps and15 channels of fixed channel_weight * ((prediction-truth)/error_scale)^2.
training.optimizer: Existing safeguarded Adam: zero initial moments, lr.002, beta.9/.999, epsilon1e-8, normclip5, scales2**-i for i0..7, full-cache strict-decrease acceptance.
training.parent_roles: Same train/development parents and recording content as each saved v1 fit; no confirmation data enter fitting.
training.precision: float64 fitting; default float32 application evaluation
training.starting_models: Exact pinned saved shared-v1 selected models, including unchanged feature/output normalizations. This resumes the end of stage one, never repeats it.
training.window_selection: All complete windows then unchanged learner._indices parent-balanced selection; no boundary crossing, padding, invented data or duplicated windows. Report excluded parents/short prefixes; Dart has 1048 complete training windows.
